verdict.rationale: cubic documents on-demand triggering by commenting `@cubic-dev-ai review this PR` and other comment interactions. Repository selection at install and cubic.yaml settings for review behavior and ignore patterns give some scoping, but nothing shows draft skipping or branch/label filters, and reviews run automatically on new PRs by default. Missing for 10: documented skip-draft setting, branch-based trigger filters, label-based trigger filters, an option to disable auto-review in favor of on-demand only, and independent corroboration.
